environmentVariables.description: Slack channel or DM ID that `report --slack` posts to by default (the --slack-channel flag overrides it). Leave blank to pass the destination on every run.

environmentVariables.description: Region for the EC2, CloudWatch and S3 calls. Cost Explorer is always served from us-east-1 regardless of this value.
environmentVariables.name: AWS_REGION

environmentVariables.description: Secret access key paired with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.
environmentVariables.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Session token, required only when the keys above are temporary STS or SSO credentials. Leave blank for long-lived IAM user keys.
environmentVariables.name: AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
